verses.1: To be destroyed by those who are far away from David, and to be held captive by the Philistines in Gath.
verses.2: God has saved me, for I am a human being. Every day, people push me down.
verses.3: They have been fighting against me all day long, because they are very angry with me.
verses.4: Today, I will come to you and comfort you.
verses.5: I praise God for His words. I trust in God; I do not fear what might happen to me.
verses.6: Today, all my words will bring sorrow to me; all their thoughts are evil.
verses.7: May they hide and wait for me; may they protect me, as my soul desires.
verses.8: On the day of judgment, God will bring down those who are evil and wicked.
verses.9: Nodi, you have written down my memories in your book. Now, they are preserved in your writings.
verses.10: Then, the enemies will return on that day. I will know then that God is with me.
verses.11: I will praise the Lord, I will speak of His greatness. I will speak of His greatness.
verses.12: In God, I trust that He will not allow anyone to do anything to me.
verses.13: May God protect you; I will fulfill your vows.
verses.14: For you have saved my soul from death; now my feet are free to walk before God in the light of life.
